purpose: numerical conditional stress test; NOT forecast, causal impact or municipal budget

independent_sensitivity.scope: independent diagnostic sensitivity to 2025 observed FPM, not a projected transfer cut

price_policy: no future inflation path assumed; all currency in BRL at September 2026 prices
population_policy: future population not forecast; projected per capita indicators must be null
revenue_policy: current revenue total modeled as one block, no fictitious projection of municipal ISS, FPM or IBS shares
capital_policy: investment modeled as a share of modeled current revenue, not a result of current revenue minus current expenditure
missing_policy: missing 2025 component remains null; do not impute as 0
qa_policy: compute municipality before subregion; regional sums only on full coverage; fiscal/legal categories remain distinct
